title.narrative: Accelerating Localisation through Partnerships (ALTP) - 5 month extension

description.narrative:
Following the completion of the ECHO-funded, 2-year consortium programme Accelerating Localisation though Partnerships, the consortium (Christian Aid, CARE, Tearfund, ActionAid, CAFOD, Oxfam) agreed to fund an additional 5 months to build on the momentum started at national and global level, further disseminate the project outputs, conduct an evaluation of the programme, and seek follow-on funding. The agreement was to allow flexibility for the national-level activities to be relevant for the context and progress, rather than one global approach.
Goal: Accelerate localisation through the strengthening of local and national leadership of humanitarian response with a focus on partnerships.
Global objectives: 1. Increased understanding and awareness of localisation and National Localisation Frameworks (and Pathways to Localisation) in 4 programme countries (and globally). 2. Localisation agenda is advanced in 4 programme countries through context-specific discussions (e.g. risks of partnerships in conflict-affected areas in Myanmar, the role of government in Nigeria and Nepal, and best practice of localisation in South Sudan). 3. Quality reporting and evaluation of Accelerating Localisation through Partnerships 2017-19 is completed.
